_comment: W8b S1 (2026-10-20): local subdivision levels per GNM vertex group for the detail layer (gnm-detail-v1). A vertex's level = max over the groups it belongs to (weight > 0.3); a skin face is split 1->4 at level L when all three vertices have level >= L; neighbouring faces get 1->2 / 1->3 transition splits. Levels are a proposal (만두 2026-10-20): eyes 2, nose 2, lips 1, chin 1. Only the skin (material 0) is subdivided.
